text:
Alex: Quick heads-up — we've got ~420 GPU reservations (mix of A100/H100) expiring in ~6 weeks across eu-west-1 and eu-central-1. Current usage is skewed to eu-west but a chunk of RIs live in eu-central. Can we map out options (consolidate workloads, exchange/sell, SavingsPlan buy) and surface any region-offset constraints?

Priya: FYI, zonal RIs generally don't offset across regions. Regional/convertible types and SavingsPlans give more flexibility. Need exact SKU split before recommending conversions.

Jin: Pulled a quick delta this morning — usage vs reserved snapshot:
```
region,gpu_reserved,gpu_active,orphaned
eu-west-1,260,310,-50
eu-central-1,160,110,50
```
Orphaned = reserved > active. Looks like we could shift ~50 GPUs' worth of demand to eu-central if latency allows.

Marco: Two pragmatic paths: 1) try to rebalance batch training to eu-central for the 50 spare slots, 2) prepare reservations to be exchanged/sold where possible. Selling/exchange has lead time and isn't guaranteed. Also consider mixing in a small Compute SavingsPlan to cover unpredictable burst.

Priya: Rough ballpark on cost: converting to regional/compute SP buys ~6-12% premium vs locked zonal RI but reduces churn. I'll run a detailed delta for the 6-week window.

Alex: Can we get a short risk matrix? Need: cost delta, lead time, operational work, perf/latency risk. Put a recommendation for 1) minimal risky move (sell/exchange + SP cushion) and 2) aggressive (rebalance + let some expire).

Jin: I'll produce the heatmap + per-account orphaned RI list by EOD. Command I used to produce the CSV:
```
# local reporting
python infra/costs/gpu_coverage.py --start -90d --end today --group-by region,account
```

Marco: +1 on the two-plan recommendation. Also check dedicated capacity pools (we have a few reserved hosts for private clusters) — those don't show up in the same billing lines.

infra-bot: created task INFRA-867: "Reservation coverage analysis — eu-west/eu-central" assigned to Jin, due 3 days from now.

Priya: Note: if we shift jobs cross-region remember data egress for large datasets — that could erase savings for heavy checkpoints. Add a data-movement cost estimate.

Alex: Good call. Jin, include estimated egress and a canary plan (1 job, non-critical dataset). Marco, can you check host-level reservations and whether any can be re-tagged to different accounts?

billing-bot: auto: created billing ticket #BILL-9122 to track RI exchange approvals and marketplace listing if needed.

Jin: Will attach the heatmap + proposed per-account plan. I'll flag any reservations that are convertible vs locked.

Marco: Also let's timebox the marketplace listing — if we can't get buyers within 2 weeks, fallback to buying a short-term compute SavingsPlan to avoid churn.

Alex: Thanks all. We'll reconvene Tue 10am UTC with the heatmap and concrete numbers. Reminder: don't move production jobs without canary. :thumbsup:
